_help: How dialogue is paced and voiced. cps: characters per second of a line at normal speed, for Latin-like scripts and for CJK (a Chinese character carries a word, so it is slower). speakers: each speaker's speed as a multiple. punctuation: extra ms after a character, per language (default applies to every language that does not list it). voices: each speaker's blip (timbre: square or triangle; note 1-8 of the C pentatonic scale, low to high) played every blip_every letters. fast_forward: speed while the confirm key is held. auto_advance_ms: the pause before the next line when auto-advance is on (A key). styles: a box per kind of speaker (palette colour names from engine/render.py); speaker_style says which kind each speaker is. battle_speech: when someone speaks during a battle (the Grimoire, a guardian's reaction, a hint, a plea for mercy), the line waits for ENTER (wait_for_enter; false: it closes by itself, extra_ms longer than a narration beat), and everything but the speech box darkens (dim: 0 none to 255 black), fading in and out over fade_ms.
